name: Trade war & tariffs
value: US proposes 20% Section 301 tariff on China
summary: US proposes Section 301 tariffs on 14 partners on 25 Nov, 20% on China and 15% on the EU; comments due 5 Jan
state: On 25 Nov the US Trade Representative proposed tariffs on 14 trading partners after a Section 301 inquiry into excess capacity, with up to 20% on Chinese goods, rising to 40% if talks fail, and 15% on the EU (Euronews via Yahoo Finance). Rates for the EU, Japan, South Korea and Taiwan stay within existing 15% deal caps; the US–China truce expires on 10 Jan (TNW). Comments are due 5 Jan and hearings start 25 Jan, so nothing is in force and Watch holds.
for_you: Exporters to the US and firms relying on Chinese inputs face uncertainty over costs into early 2027.
rubric_hit: New major tariffs proposed between large economies = Watch; not yet in force, no retaliation

sources.title: Yahoo Finance (Euronews) — US proposes new tariffs on 14 major trading partners, the EU included
TNW — US proposes new tariffs on 14 trading partners, including China and the EU

why: Tariffs raise prices, reroute supply chains and slow growth; escalation cycles hurt export-heavy economies like the UK's partners.
drivers: US tariff policy, retaliation, court rulings, trade deals, WTO disputes.

rubric.alert: Broad new tariffs in force with retaliation under way, or US average effective tariff rising sharply.
rubric.watch: New major tariffs announced or threatened between large economies.
rubric.normal: Tariff regime stable; no new major measures in the past two weeks.
